name: Uttarakhand
summary: Known as 'Dev Bhoomi'. Source of the holy rivers Ganga (Gangotri) and Yamuna (Yamunotri). Home to the sacred Char Dham (Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri) and India's first Uniform Civil Code (UCC).
festivals: Kumbh Mela (Haridwar), Nanda Devi Raj Jat, Ganga Dussehra, Phool Dei
rivers: Ganga (Bhagirathi + Alaknanda at Devprayag), Yamuna, Mandakini, Pindar
monuments: Kedarnath Temple (Jyotirlinga), Badrinath Temple, Jageshwar Temples, Tehri Dam (highest dam in India, 260.5m)
nationalParks: Jim Corbett National Park (India's oldest, est. 1936), Nanda Devi & Valley of Flowers (UNESCO)
schemes: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Yojana, Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana, Uniform Civil Code (UCC)

mcqs.q: India's first and oldest national park, established in 1936 as Hailey National Park, is situated in which district of Uttarakhand?
mcqs.exp: Established in 1936 to protect the Bengal tiger, it was renamed Jim Corbett National Park in 1957.

mcqs.q: At which holy confluence (Prayag) do the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers unite to officially become the River Ganga?
mcqs.exp: At Devprayag, the Bhagirathi joins the Alaknanda, and the combined stream flows forward as the holy Ganga.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Uttarakhand.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Dehradun (Winter), Gairsain (Summer). Uttarakhand covers a geographic area of 53,483 sq km across 13 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Ganga (Bhagirathi + Alaknanda at Devprayag), Yamuna, Mandakini, Pindar.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as 'Dev Bhoomi'. Source of the holy rivers Ganga (Gangotri) and Yamuna (Yamunotri). Home to the sacred Char Dham (Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri) and India's first Uniform Civil Code (UCC).

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Uttarakhand.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Uttarakhand was formally instituted on 9 November 2000. Official language(s): Hindi, Sanskrit.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Chholiya (Sword dance), Jhora, Chhapeli.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Kumbh Mela (Haridwar), Nanda Devi Raj Jat, Ganga Dussehra, Phool Dei.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Uttarakhand.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Lt. Gen. Gurmit Singh.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Uttarakhand is Pushkar Singh Dhami.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Uttarakhand High Court (Nainital).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Alpine musk deer | State Bird: Himalayan monal | State Flower: Brahma Kamal | State Tree: Burans (Rhododendron).

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Uttarakhand.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Limestone, Magnesite, Gypsum, Rock Phosphate.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Uttarakhand plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Uttarakhand.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Kedarnath Temple (Jyotirlinga), Badrinath Temple, Jageshwar Temples, Tehri Dam (highest dam in India, 260.5m).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Jim Corbett National Park (India's oldest, est. 1936), Nanda Devi & Valley of Flowers (UNESCO).

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Uttarakhand.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Yojana, Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana, Uniform Civil Code (UCC).
